title_zh: 看清纪念品价签的币种

scenario.label_zh: 核对纪念品价格和币种
scenario.goal_zh: 看懂手写价签后确定付款方式

context_zh: 游客在纪念品店询问手写价签，并确认付款方式。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: I can read the number fifteen on this tag, but what currency is it in?

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Euros. That mark is a handwritten euro sign.

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: Thank you. Do you accept cards for something this small?

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Yes. The total will be fifteen euros on your card.

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: Then I will pay by card rather than use my remaining cash.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Certainly. I will bring the card reader over.
